about: Authored frozen-art integration review record (reviewer decisions; spoiler-safe: ids, screen keys and generic descriptions only). tools/art-integration.mjs combines it with the live runtime to generate docs/art_integration/INTEGRATION_MATRIX.json. Statuses that the runtime can prove (integrated, placeholder, no art) are derived, never authored here.
